simple.meaning: עָמַם (ʻâmam) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “to associate ; by implication, to overshadow (by huddling together).” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 3 times across Lamentations, Ezekiel, beginning at Lamentations 4:1. Its meaning is built by comparing the passages where Scripture uses it.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to עָמַם (H6004).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.
simple.summary: עָמַם (ʻâmam) / H6004 is traced through Lamentations 4:1, Ezekiel 28:3, Ezekiel 31:8 as a generated source-based concept entry.

definitions.short: to associate ; by implication, to overshadow (by huddling together)
definitions.full: H6004. amam II. [ עָמַם ] verb darken, dim (Late Hebrew id. ; Arabic cover, veil, conceal ; עֲמַם ᵑ7 grow dark ); — Qal Perfect 3plural suffix עֲמָמֻהוּ Ezek 31:8 dubious, but probably (as Thes) cedars did not eclipse him ; עֲמָמוּךָ 28:3 no secret do they hold dark (= is held dark) for thee (Ges § 117x ). Hoph`al Imperfect 3masculine singular זָהָב יוּעַם Lam 4:1 (figurative) how is the gold dimmed ! compare Bu. עַמְמֵי עֲמָמִים, see I. עַם above עִמָּנוּאֵל see below עִם above

occurrences.englishText: How the gold has become dim!
behold, you are wiser than Daniel;
The cedars in the garden of God could not hide it.
